card.name: Patient adherence and compliance wording
card.fires_on: Words about a patient following or failing to follow a treatment plan, such as adhere, comply, non-compliance, and lost to follow-up. It fires on the word itself or the piece just before it ends.

modes.label: Adhere or comply
modes.description: Verbs saying patients must stick to monitoring or insulin rules.
modes.example: SYMLIN should be used only in patients who can fully understand and<< adhere>> to proper insulin adjustments and glucose monitoring.

modes.label: Non-adherence or non-compliance
modes.description: Inside the word non-adherence or noncompliance, partway through the word.
modes.example: • non<<com>>pliance with self-monitoring of blood glucose

modes.label: Lost to follow-up / compliance phrases
modes.description: Phrases about follow-up or compliance with a regimen.
